comments: a0d7c4f5: This routine is used for generating deficiency reports.
e0e695b7: Check if multiple divisions are selected and proceed to division selection if true.
6a569145: If multiple divisions are not selected, automatically select the first division.
14dee6d6: Call the selected report type routine.
a2229520: Call the routine to select the date range for the report.
f491aeee: Select deficiencies using VAUTOMA generic selection utility.
b482214a: Prompt for additional selection criteria specific to the report.
59185a38: Alert the user that the report is formatted for 132 column output.
d75e20aa: Get the current date and time, format it for display.
a3367fcd: Setup variables for the report, call the device handler, and start the report output if the device is selected.
b873b918: Exit point for the routine.
b4043d24: Start processing the report, looping through deficiencies.
290ba0f9: If the report type is 1 or 3 and there are records, proceed to the detailed report output routine.
5c72aca2: If the report type is 2 and there are records, proceed to the summary report output routine.
cbc61bb6: Print a message if no records meet the criteria.
43c20438: Return to the calling routine.
31da0e83: Specialty and Service processing section.
58349935: Get the admission related to the deficiency.
c7b3bedb: Check if the admission exists, then find the corresponding specialty and service.
1c1d35b4: Determine the ward location for the admission.
ea992790: Set the division based on the ward location.
b08e3e20: Retrieve the division data.
db7b8c3d: Determine the service related to the ward.
8a9920f2: Handle cases where service is not specified.
e870a2be: Set the specialty, checking against user selections if necessary.
7120bf4a: End of the specialty and service processing section.
ab1e46ba: Check division selection against the deficiency record's division.
3b4276b3: Ensure the deficiency's division matches the selected division.
6cbd2e5b: Exclude records with 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' status if the division setting is specific.
c8af8d7c: Exclude records with 'REVIEWED' status if the division setting requires exclusion.
c3d11362: Exclude records with 'COMPLETED' status, cleaning up temporary variables.
f103b66b: Cleanup of temporary variables used in status checks.
4fa95cc0: Exclude records without a responsible physician if required by report settings.
c5945b5a: Exclude records with a responsible physician if specified by report settings.
16eb8d53: Check against selected deficiencies.
d1c90f6a: Exclude records outside the selected date range.
fe374bad: For physician reports, exclude records not matching selected physicians.
71900f58: For patient reports, exclude records not matching selected patients.
5e27c8ac: Exclude summary records if not within the report's scope.
7925b223: Set the division name for report grouping.
445a7f97: Set the patient name for report grouping.
14e1f7d3: Physician report: Group records by division, physician, and patient.
51f45ebc: Patient report: Group records by division, patient, and physician.
37c41a38: Service report: Group by division, service, and specialty for records with a specified service.
c6f684ec: Service report: Filter by selected services.
6a543a6e: Service report: Filter by selected specialties.
6816afd1: Exit if any record does not meet the report criteria.
76819843: For service reports, organize records for output.
4d179b34: End of the record check and grouping section.
55d85e0d: Setup for physician selection.
7f679d24: End of physician selection setup.
941c9c71: Patient selection setup.
67f1e7bc: End of patient selection setup.
a28d0375: Service selection setup.
d5756d9a: Specialty selection setup.
4c17556f: End of service and specialty selection setup.
